title: introduce credential-fanout + session-hints + typed-async-streams; align retry presets and bump ts-sdk to 2.3.1
author: Aisha Raman
release_notes: TS SDK 2.3.1: credential fanout, session hinting, typed async stream ergonomics, retry preset consolidation, docs and examples updated
description:
Summary: This PR implements a cross-cutting set of ergonomics and auth improvements for the TypeScript SDK coordinated with companion changes in Python and Go. The goals are: 1) Add a credential-fanout mode for delegated auth flows so callers can provide multiple credential providers and the SDK will try them in parallel, preferring warm tokens and falling back gracefully. 2) Surface optional session_hints on streaming and request constructors to allow servers and smart routing to better warm caches and favor affinity. 3) Introduce typed async-iterable streams (StreamCursor<T>) as a first-class ergonomic surface for consumers that need compile-time payload shapes. 4) Consolidate retry presets into a compact retry-presets.json and add two new profiles (low-latency and throughput-friendly) to align with runtime defaults. 5) Bump the SDK to v2.3.1 and update changelog/examples.

Motivation and context: Several product customers and internal platform teams requested better cross-SDK parity for delegated-auth flows and streaming ergonomics. Python/Go work (parallel PRs in their respective repos) provide the underlying session/credential machinery; this TS PR focuses on API ergonomics and alignment with those runtime primitives. The credential fanout reduces tail latency when a primary token fetch is slow and avoids cascading fallbacks. Session hints let the control plane and hosting runtime perform smarter KV cache prefetch and routing decisions. Typed streams improve DX for Typescript consumers (fewer castings, better editor completions) and reduce common integration bugs.

Description of changes (high level):
- auth/cred: new CredFanoutProvider interface and implementation that accepts an ordered list of providers and races warm fetches while honoring priority and cancellation semantics. Added unit tests and integration mocks. Updated README with example usage and migration notes.
- session: request/session constructors now accept optional session_hints: {intent?: string, model_sig?: string, affinity?: string}. Hints are propagated via metadata headers to allow the control plane to optimize routing/cache-warmup.
- streaming: introduce StreamCursor<T> typed async iterator wrapper with helper adapters from existing push/pull stream surfaces to maintain backward compatibility. Added examples for chat streaming with typed delta objects.
- retry: replaced scattered retry presets with retry-presets.json (compact DSL); added 'latency-sensitive' and 'throughput-preferred' profiles and mapped default to the runtime-config recommended profile. Deprecated old config keys but provided adapter layer for backward compatibility.
- docs & examples: update README, migration guide (docs/migration/cred-fanout.md), and example apps to demonstrate new session_hints and typed streams.
- version bump: package.json and package-lock updated to 2.3.1, SDK changelog appended with migration guidance.

Commits (summary):
- a1b2c3d add cred-fanout provider and tests
- b2c3d4e add session_hints plumbing and header propagation
- c3d4e5f introduce StreamCursor<T> typed async iterable
- d4e5f6a consolidate retry presets and add profiles
- e5f6a7b examples and docs updates
- f6a7b8c bump version to 2.3.1 and update changelog

Files/areas changed (high level):
- src/auth/credFanout.ts
- src/auth/providers/* (new test harness)
- src/session/session.ts
- src/stream/streamCursor.ts
- config/retry-presets.json
- examples/typed-chat-stream/...
- docs/migration/cred-fanout.md
- package.json, package-lock.json, CHANGELOG.md

Testing and CI: All unit tests and integration mocks were added; CI shows green on branch. Notable checks: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), lint (pass), typecheck (pass), integration-sim (pass). Some flaky e2e cases for the streaming harness were observed in early runs but were resolved by adding deterministic clock in the stream test harness.

Backwards compatibility and migration notes: The new APIs are additive. Existing consumers using the old push/pull API continue to work. The retry preset consolidation retains old keys via an adapter until the next major release. Credential fanout defaults to off; opt-in via new constructor arg or environment flag. Session_hints are optional and ignored by older runtimes.

Security considerations: Credential providers now receive a minimal cancellation token and are raced; providers must not perform long-running side effects on cancellation. Updates to the auth test harness validate that secrets are not logged and that providers respect early cancellation.

Review conversation (selected excerpts):
- Carlos Vega (reviewer): "Nice consolidation. Two requests: 1) can we add a small benchmark for the fanout path to show latency improvement under slow primary provider? 2) prefer 'sessionHints' camelCase in public surface to match TS consumers." 
- Aisha Raman (author): "Added micro-bench harness under test/bench/cred-fanout and switched exported name to sessionHints in the public index. Kept session_hints in header payload to match runtime wiring (control plane expects snake_case)."
- James Lin (reviewer): "StreamCursor<T> looks good, but please add an example showing error propagation semantics when the connection closes mid-stream." 
- Aisha Raman: "Added example and updated tests to assert proper error forwarding on stream termination."
- Marta Ivanova (final approver): "Approvals after minor nitfixes to docs and changelog formatting. Will squash-merge once CI is green." 

CI timeline and flakiness notes: Two early CI runs failed on flakey e2e stream test due to race on mock server shutdown. Fix was to introduce deterministic mock-server shutdown and a short drain wait in tests. After that fix, CI passes consistently.

Migration examples (short):
- Old: const stream = sdk.createChatStream({model: 'x'}); for await (const chunk of stream) { ... }
- New typed: const stream = sdk.createChatStream<{delta:{text?:string}}>({model: 'x', sessionHints: {intent: 'compose', affinity: 'us-east-1'}}); for await (const delta of stream.cursor()) { /* delta.delta.text */ }

Rollout plan: We will ship the TS SDK 2.3.1 to npm as a non-breaking minor with release notes and a short migration guide. We coordinated with the Python and Go SDK teams to release companion changes the same week to avoid cross-SDK parity gaps. We will monitor errors and adoption via a short-term telemetry tag and keep the backward adapter layer for one minor cycle.

Merge: Squash-merged by Marta Ivanova. Merge commit: "squash: credential fanout + session hints + typed streams; bump to 2.3.1" (merge sha: deadbeef1234567890).

Follow-ups (post-merge):
- ENG-2145: add a small perf benchmark job to CI comparing fanout vs single-provider in high-latency scenarios.
- ENG-2150: surface a helper generator to convert legacy push streams to typed StreamCursor in the next patch.

Related: companion PRs were opened in redwood-sdk-python and redwood-sdk-go to add the low-level credential orchestration primitives and to coordinate policy names for retry-presets. See linked linear items for cross-repo tracking.

If you want a quick demo snippet or a minimal migration PR for a consumer repo, I can prepare that as a follow-up.
